It is now recognized that both children and adults worldwide are at risk for developing vitamin D deﬁciency and sufﬁciency. The
Endocrine Society Guidelines deﬁnes deﬁciency and insufﬁciency as a serum concentration of 25-hydroxyvitamin D [25(OH)D]
of <20 ng mL1 (<50 nmol L1) and 21–29 ng mL1 (51–74 nmol L1) respectively. Vitamin D sufﬁciency is deﬁned as a serum
